heading: Everyday Akhlaq
summary: Everyday Akhlaq is a collection of fictional character scenarios about ordinary decisions. Work through a conversation or choice, read the imagined consequence and return to the source reading. The scenarios offer space to reflect on conduct without asking you to disclose a private incident or treat a fictional outcome as a prediction.
steps: Choose a scenario that interests you or filter by setting.
Read the scenario and make a choice before inspecting the fictional consequence.
Compare the source reading and reflection prompts with the choices in the exercise.

questions.question: Are the consequences predictions about real people?
questions.answer: No. Scenarios and consequences are fictional editorial exercises. They illustrate questions for reflection; they cannot predict how a real person will respond.

questions.question: Do I need to enter my own experience?
questions.answer: No. You can use the supplied scenarios without sharing names or personal stories. Keep a group discussion focused on fictional examples if a topic feels private.

related.name: Family Halaqa
related.description: Choose an age-appropriate pack and learn together, without profiles.
